en: "Look at that, Mr. {hero:6}!{n} Could those be{n} undead monsters, maaaybe?"
"Yeah, skeletons, by the look of it.{n} Corpses made into soldiers{n} by some powerful magic."
"So, what do we dooo?"
"It's only a few skeletons.{n} Just right for testing our skills."
"It's only a few skeletons!{n} We'll crush them in one go!"
"We're only up against a few skeletons!{n} No panic, no fuss,{n} let's fight nice and eeeasy!"
"They're nothing much, sir.{n} I could beat enemies like those{n} with one hand!"
"A worthless enemy, sir!{n} Let's settle this in an instant!"
"Tee hee! Some measly undead?{n} With my powers, they're{n} easy-peasy!"
"You dead who have risen from hell,{n} do not resent us. We shall surely{n} fell you and lay your souls to rest."
"And yet, I have a bad feeling{n} about this..."
"Hmm? Monsters of nothing but bone!?{n} They don't look strong, but they{n} give me the creeps, I tell you!"
"The targets are spiritual life forms..."
"However, the energy readings I sense{n} from this ground are rather high{n} for that alone...?"
"For a mere few skeleton soldiers,{n} I sense a strangely strong ki..."
"Ah, the poor undying dead.{n} With my holy arts, let me at least{n} lay them to eternal sleep."
"Undead are not so very rare on this{n} island, yes indeed! Creatures from{n} all over the world live here!"
"C'mon... c'mon... c'mon..."
"...Nah, against crap like that{n} I can't get fired up. Hey, {hero:6},{n} let's just half-ass this one, huh?"
"Warriors who... cannot even die...{n} ...A pitiful lot... but I suppose...{n} I'm the same as them... in the end..."
"What!? What's going on!?"
"What... in the world is thiiis!?"
"All right, wiped them out easy!"
"Okay, and that's the end of thaaat!"
"What was that just now!?"
"Watch out! That's strongly acidic gas!{n} The damage alone looks heavy,{n} and it seems to be poisonous too!"
"To think an undead this huge{n} was lurking undergrouuund!?"
"The boss of those skeletons{n} from before... or so it seems!"
"You who stand before my statue:{n} are you one who will dispel{n} the darkness of the world?"
"Hey, hey, what's going on here?{n} The statue's yapping away!"
"My name is Beauty God Aphrodite, one{n} of the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"A blink of an eye to us, a long age{n} to you: a hundred years have we{n} marked upon this island."
"And now, upon this island, the seal{n} on us Twelve Gods has been broken."
"Hmph, a well-made machine. It reacts{n} to whoever holds a ring and talks{n} automatically. That's the trick."
"Still, these so-called Ancient Gods{n} sure made nothing but weird stuff."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."
"When you have gathered all twelve{n} rings, we shall acknowledge you{n} as the agent of the gods."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"The seal has been broken."
"The seal on us Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} has been broken after a hundred years."
"Agent of the gods, huh?{n} Set the course of this world right, huh?"
"Man, what a roundabout way to talk.{n} Basically, I just have to collect{n} twelve rings lying around somewhere."
"And if I do, I get my hands on{n} some incredible power, right?"
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"My name is Beauty God Aphrodite."
"Now is the time to fulfill{n} the ancient covenant."
"My name is Beauty God Aphrodite."
"Now that's a well-made gimmick.{n} In the blink of an eye, the statue{n} turned into this tiny little ring."
"These Ancient Gods who made it{n} must've really loved theatrics."
"Then again, it's sure to be a hit{n} with military men who love theatrics.{n} So bad they can taste it..."
"Well, whatever."
"This ring's supposed to be a key,{n} right? So if I collect twelve, I get{n} to lay eyes on the Almighty Treasure?"
"Looks like this trip just got{n} a bit more interesting."
"A giant dragon, from underground!?"
"This is no ordinary dragon!?{n} It's rotting!? Its whole body{n} is melting into slime!?"
"It can't be... a dragon zombieee!?"
"Yeah, looks like it!"
"The strongest undead monster{n} in this world. A legendary beast{n} with an immortal body!"
"You who stand before my statue:{n} are you one who will dispel{n} the darkness of the world?"
"Oh my? The statue is talking? But{n} these words seem to speak{n} straight into my heart?"
"My name is Beauty God Aphrodite, one{n} of the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"A blink of an eye to us, a long age{n} to you: a hundred years have we{n} marked upon this island."
"And now, upon this island, the seal{n} on us Twelve Gods has been broken."
"The Zodiac Twelve Gods?"
"Grandfather taught me looong ago.{n} They are gods with a power for good{n} who set the course of the world right."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."

"Set it right."

"Could that be the Almighty Treasure{n} said to sleep on this island?"

"My name is Beauty God Aphrodite."
"The Zodiac Twelve Gods, a broken{n} seal, 'set the course of this world{n} right'... What could it all meeean?"
"But I can say this much, I thiiink."
"The treasure sleeping on this island{n} doesn't seem to be the wonderful{n} thing the soldiers say it iiis."
"The Almighty Treasure, hmmm..."
"So it was for this ring that{n} Hector's life was lost..."
"Sniff..."

"So that's one step closer to the{n} so-called Almighty Treasure{n} sleeping on this island."

"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"One more of the twelve rings.{n} But there still seems to be{n} a long road ahead."
"Heh, looks like having its pals{n} killed has put it in{n} a seriously foul mood."
"Still, what a tremendous roooar!"
"An undead of the savage dragon race.{n} Its stamina's likely off the charts,{n} and it spits poison breath on top."
"Even so, all we can do is fight...{n} riiight?"
"Yeah. If you want to stay alive."
"Let's regroup our formatiooon!"
"Avoid direct attacks if you can!{n} Use the Voids as shields! Protect{n} yourselves while dealing damage!"
"Let's send the Voids out in front!{n} It doesn't look like something we{n} can beat by fighting it head-ooon!"
"Bio-energy readings still increasing.{n} But for an undead life form{n} to possess this much power..."
"This does not appear to be a monster{n} born of nature. An artificially{n} created experimental creature?"
"I sense a terribly evil ki. Hatred{n} toward the living, or perhaps{n} an overwhelming urge to die."
"As expected of you, Master Ozunu.{n} You detected the dragon's lingering{n} will from the flow of ki?"
"The feng shui arts read the flow of{n} ki. Their roots differ a little from{n} your black magic, Master Faust."
"When this battle is over, I hope{n} we may teach each other the arts{n} of East and West, Master Ozunu."
"For that, we must first survive."
"Yes."
"Uhohohoho!? Now this is something!{n} It's so tremendous that{n} I went and wet myself a little!"
"Ewww! You filthy old man!{n} Don't come over here! Geez!"
"Don't say that, Alice dear!"
"I! Said! Stay away from meee!"
"Ah, evil soul lost in this world.{n} Truly, I would like to grant you{n} rest with my holy arts, but..."
"This dragon is far too strong.{n} I am still in training. Can power{n} as meager as mine even fight it?"
"It is veeery big, yes indeed!{n} It must be the big boss of the{n} undead living on this island!"
"Still, giant undead though it is,{n} if we strike it with powerful{n} attacks, we will surely damage it."
"Stay back, Prince {hero:6}!{n} Even if it costs me my life,{n} I'll protect my prince!"
"I sense a dreadful wave of evil.{n} It hates us, the living, and will{n} attack us on impulse."
"C'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon!{n} A giant monster like this is{n} a worthy opponent for yours truly!"
"Watch! With this heavy MG of mine,{n} I'll turn it back into the corpse{n} it's supposed to be!"
"Can we win... against that giant...?{n} ...No... even if we lose... what{n} awaits me is... a peaceful death..."
"In that you are mistaken, Jaguar."
"We may truly die in peace only once{n} we have protected {name:6}, who{n} saved our lives, to the very end..."
"I see... you're right..."
"Then let us go together, Jaguar.{n} Those who share a purpose are called{n} comrades. Are you and I not comrades?"
"Comrades... a word I haven't heard{n} in a long while..."
"We'll be fine, Lt. {hero:6}, sir!{n} Our harsh training at the Special{n} Service Agency won't go to waste!"
"On the proud name of Romulus!{n} I, Cerbera, will not fall back{n} before some mere undead, sir!"
"Good. Undead or not,{n} we can definitely damage it!"
"It looks like we're okay, everyone!{n} Even if it's an undying creature,{n} we can still damage iiit!"
"Tch! Watch out for that breath!{n} Take it head-on and you get{n} poisoned on top of the damage!"
"Please watch out for the poison{n} breeeath! It's not just damage,{n} you'll get poisoned tooo!"
"Should you be poisoned,{n} I will cure you! That is my duty{n} as an army chaplain!"
"But it is not only the poison breath!{n} Get close and those fangs will{n} bite you! Dangerous, yes indeed!"
"Machine though I am, if I am{n} poisoned, even my external sensors{n} will suffer critical damage."
"I must evade that attack."
"Aaargh! Who gives a damn about poison!{n} We just gotta finish it off before{n} the poison gets all through us!"
"I see... a poison breath attack...{n} ...But... my knife takes a life...{n} more surely than poison..."
"Heh! Serves you right,{n} you rotten dragon bastard!"
"A half-dead thing like you defying us{n} living humans, your betters. That's{n} what lost it for you from the start!"
"We did it, we wooon!"
"And it's all thanks to everyone!{n} Let's hurry back to camp and{n} rest up from the fiiight!"
"Hey, see that?"
"Oh my? A Zodiac Twelve Gods statue,{n} out of the dragon's corpse!?{n} How in the world did thaaat happen!?"
"Dragon zombies are known for eating{n} anything. It probably swallowed{n} the statue that stood here..."
"But to swallow even a statue,{n} it must have been awfully huuungry."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
